weeks.title: Introduction to Software Engineering Process:
weeks.content: Pengenalan kepada Proses Kejuruteraan Perisian: Definisi dan kepentingan proses perisian; hubungan antara proses, produk dan kualiti; gambaran keseluruhan fasa kitar hayat perisian. Introduction to Software Engineering Process: Definition and importance of software process; relationship between process, product and quality; overview of software lifecycle phases

weeks.title: Software Development Process Models:
weeks.content: Model Proses Pembangunan Perisian: Pengenalan kepada model Waterfall, Incremental, Iterative, Prototyping dan Spiral; ciri-ciri, kekuatan dan kekangan setiap model. Software Development Process Models: Overview of Waterfall, Incremental, Iterative, Prototyping and Spiral models; characteristics, strengths and limitations of each model.

weeks.title: Agile and Scrum Process:
weeks.content: Proses Agile dan Scrum: Nilai dan prinsip Agile; peranan, acara dan artifak Scrum; kesesuaian proses berasaskan Agile dalam projek perisian. Agile and Scrum Process: Agile values and principles; Scrum roles, events and artefacts; suitability of Agile-based process in software projects.

weeks.title: Selecting an Appropriate Process Model:
weeks.content: Pemilihan Model Proses yang Sesuai: Faktor yang mempengaruhi pemilihan model proses seperti saiz projek, kestabilan keperluan, risiko, keupayaan pasukan, tempoh masa dan keperluan pihak berkepentingan. Selecting an Appropriate Process Model: Factors affecting process model selection such as project size, requirements stability, risk, team capability, timeline and stakeholder needs

weeks.title: Software Process Roles and Responsibilities
weeks.content: Tanggungjawab dan peranan software process Memecahkan aktiviti proses kepada peranan pasukan dan tanggungjawab individu; mengenal pasti pemilikan tugasan; menghubungkan fasa proses dengan hasil kerja. Software Process Roles and Responsibilities Breaking down process activities into team roles and individual responsibilities; identifying task ownership; linking process phases to deliverables

weeks.title: Task Planning and Team Commitment:
weeks.content: Perancangan Tugasan dan Komitmen Pasukan: Merancang kerja berdasarkan tanggungjawab yang dipersetujui; pengagihan, keutamaan dan penjadualan tugasan; komitmen terhadap tugasan yang diberikan dalam pasukan. Task Planning and Team Commitment: Planning work based on agreed responsibilities; task allocation, prioritisation and scheduling; commitment to assigned tasks within a team setting

weeks.title: Software Process Execution and Team Coordination:
weeks.content: Pelaksanaan Proses Perisian dan Penyelarasan Pasukan: Melaksanakan aktiviti proses perisian mengikut perancangan dan model proses yang dipilih; menyelaras tugasan dan kebergantungan antara ahli pasukan; melaporkan kemajuan kerja; mengurus isu dan perubahan; serta memastikan kerjasama pasukan menyokong pelaksanaan proses secara berkesan. Software Process Execution and Team Coordination: Executing software process activities according to the agreed plan and selected process model; coordinating tasks and dependencies among team members; reporting work progress; managing issues and changes; and maintaining effective collaboration to support process execution.

weeks.title: Software Development Documentation:
weeks.content: Dokumentasi Pembangunan Perisian: Tujuan dan struktur dokumentasi pembangunan perisian; penyediaan dokumentasi yang lengkap dan konsisten bagi menyokong aktiviti pembangunan perisian. Software Development Documentation: Purpose and structure of software development documents; preparation of complete and consistent documentation to support software development activities

weeks.title: Monitoring Project Progress Data:
weeks.content: Pemantauan Data Kemajuan Projek: Memantau status projek menggunakan penunjuk kemajuan seperti pencapaian, papan tugasan, carta burn-down dan rekod penyempurnaan; mentafsir data kemajuan projek. Monitoring Project Progress Data: Monitoring project status using progress indicators such as milestones, task boards, burn-down charts and completion records; interpreting project progress data.

weeks.title: Software Process Analysis Approaches:
weeks.content: Pendekatan Analisis Proses Perisian: Menganalisis aliran kerja, kekangan, kelewatan, kebergantungan dan ketidakcekapan dalam sesuatu proses perisian menggunakan pelbagai pendekatan analisis. Software Process Analysis Approaches: Analysing workflow, bottlenecks, delays, dependencies and inefficiencies in a software process using different analysis approaches

weeks.title: Quality Analysis in Software Process:
weeks.content: Analisis Kualiti dalam Proses Perisian: Meneliti isu berkaitan kualiti seperti kecacatan, kerja semula, pematuhan, konsistensi dan keberkesanan proses; mentafsir dapatan kualiti untuk penambahbaikan. Quality Analysis in Software Process: Examining quality-related issues such as defects, rework, compliance, consistency and process effectiveness; interpreting quality findings for improvement.

weeks.title: Retrospective in Software Development Team:
weeks.content: Retrospektif dalam Pasukan Pembangunan Perisian: Melaksanakan aktiviti retrospektif untuk mengenal pasti kekuatan, kelemahan dan pengajaran yang diperoleh; membincangkan kapasiti pasukan dan cabaran semasa pelaksanaan proses. Retrospective in Software Development Team: Conducting retrospective activities to identify strengths, weaknesses and lessons learned; discussing team capacity and challenges encountered during process execution

weeks.title: Software Lifecycle Process Improvement:
weeks.content: Penambahbaikan Proses Kitar Hayat Perisian: Mencadangkan dan mewajarkan penambahbaikan terhadap proses kitar hayat perisian berdasarkan kapasiti pasukan, data kemajuan projek dan analisis kualiti. Software Lifecycle Process Improvement: Proposing and justifying improvements to the software lifecycle process based on team capacity, project progress data and quality analysis

weeks.title: Software Process Evaluation and Lessons Learned Software Process Evaluation and Lessons Learned:
weeks.content: Software Process Evaluation and Lessons Learned Menilai keberkesanan proses pembangunan yang dilaksanakan; membandingkan proses yang dirancang dengan pelaksanaan sebenar; menilai kekuatan, kelemahan dan kesesuaian proses; merumuskan pembelajaran dan cadangan penambahbaikan. Software Process Evaluation and Lessons Learned Software Process Evaluation and Lessons Learned: Evaluating the effectiveness of the implemented software process; comparing planned and actual process execution; examining process strengths, weaknesses and suitability; consolidating lessons learned and recommendations for future projects.
